items.text: Zvanzi naJehovha Wamasimba Ose, Mwari waIsraeri: "Ine nhamo Nebho, nokuti ichaparadzwa.
muHeshibhoni varume vacharangana nezvokuwa kwaro, vachiti: 'Uyai, tiparadze rudzi urwo.'
Sezvo muchivimba namabasa uye nepfuma yenyu,
"Ngaatukwe uyo anobata basa raJehovha asina hanya!
Ngaatukwe uyo anodzora munondo wake pakuteura ropa!
"Moabhu anga ane zororo kubvira pauduku hwake,
isina kudirwa kubva muno mumwe mudziyo ichiiswa muno mumwe,
Moabhu ichaparadzwa, uye maguta ayo acharwiswa;
ndizvo zvinotaura Mambo, ane zita rinonzi Jehovha Wamasimba Ose.
Bvunzai murume ari kutiza nomukadzi apunyuka,
nokumaguta ose eMoabhu ari kure neari pedyo.
Ko, Israeri haana kuva chinhu chinosekwa nemi here?
Ko, akabatwa ari pakati pembavha here,
Siyai maguta enyu mundogara pakati pamatombo,
kuzvikudza kwavo nokuzvitutumadza namanyawi emwoyo wayo.
Ndinoziva kusindimara kwayo asi hakuna maturo,"
kubva kuZoari kusvikira kuHoronaimi neEgirati Sherishiya,
kuna avo vanopa zvipiriso panzvimbo dzakakwirira,
uye vanopisira zvinonhuhwira kuna vamwari vavo,"
"Saka mwoyo wangu unorira senyere pamusoro peMoabhu;
unorira senyere pamusoro pavarume veKiri Hareseti.
